messages:
maria_support: FYI — customer reported embedding vector length changed unexpectedly after we applied a locked variant for them. They pinned to a variant yesterday and now embeddings are 1024 where they were 1536. attaching minimal repro we got from them. :eyes:
jamal_se: thanks, can you paste the exact API payload and response? wonder if it's a traversal to a different model id or a fallback.
maria_support: pasted below (redacted keys). note the model string they pinned to: `rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11`
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11",
  "input": ["foo bar"],
  "client_batch_size": 8
}
```

Response:
```
200 OK
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.001, ...], "length": 1024 }
  ],
  "model": "rwd-embed-1024-compat",
  "usage": {"input_tokens": 3}
}
```

ana_research: interesting — the response model field shows `rwd-embed-1024-compat` which means the router served a different variant. That could explain the dim change.
jamal_se: did they pin to the catalog name or to a runtime variant id? if they pinned the high-level model name we could have routed to a compatible variant after the rollout.
maria_support: they explicitly used the pinned variant id from the UI; their contract shows a lock token. They swear they used the lock id from the console.
eli_infra: ops_bot logged a failed node+fallback at 2026-02-11T14:12:02Z in region us-east-1 around that time — routing rule kicked in and fell back to the 1024 variant due to a kernel mismatch on the reserved pool. I can link logs. :link: 
ops_bot: [auto] fallback_event: req=cid-ABCD1234 src_variant=rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11 fallback_variant=rwd-embed-1024-compat reason=kernel-missing node_id=gpu-node-72
sre_oncall: marking high priority — this is a customer-facing regression. we need repro steps and a mitigation path ASAP.
jamal_se: immediate triage plan: 1) confirm model manifest for pinned ID (embedding_dim field) 2) check routing decision trace for the request 3) repro in staging with the pinned ID 4) if routing logic mis-matched, add hard pin enforcement for this tenant while we investigate.
nana_research: to help, i dumped the model manifests from catalog:
```
# manifest for rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11
{
  "id": "rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11",
  "embedding_dim": 1536,
  "variants": ["rwd-embed-1536-optim","rwd-embed-1536-quant" ]
}
# manifest for rwd-embed-1024-compat
{
  "id": "rwd-embed-1024-compat",
  "embedding_dim": 1024
}
```

eli_infra: routing trace for the request (sanitized): `trace: route->pool(reserved-tenant-387)->node(gpu-node-72)->kernel_error->fallback->rwd-embed-1024-compat`
maria_support: customer is seeing search index mismatches now. they've frozen deploys. they want a rollback or a config to force the original embeddings back.
jamal_se: short-term mitigation options: A) force hard routing to pool nodes that have 1536 kernels (if available) B) temporarily serve from a hosted replica of the correct variant (costly) C) instruct customer to reindex to 1024 (bad UX). prefer A or B.
eli_infra: we can push a sticky pin for tenant 387 that bypasses fallback for that group's reserved pool. will require a quick migration window but doable.
sre_oncall: please schedule the sticky pin now and notify the customer that we will apply it and run a canary. set maintenance window 15m.
ops_bot: [auto] escalation_ticket created: INC-2026-3427 assigned to jamal_se/eli_infra, severity=P1
maria_support: i've notified the customer and got permission to proceed with a non-disruptive pin if you can guarantee no downtime. they prefer we avoid reindexing. :thumbsup: 
jamal_se: i'll repro in staging with their exact pinned id and `client_batch_size: 1` to rule out batch concat/trim bugs. please also attach the raw base64 of the embedding returned so we can assert dim at byte level.
nana_research: also cross-check the KV cache keys — if cache warmness maps to 1024 variant outputs we might be returning cached vectors from the wrong variant after a rollout.
eli_infra: grabbing full node logs and kernel version diff now.
sre_oncall: keep thread updated. once sticky pin is applied, validate by running a small traffic sample and checking `model` field in response equals pinned id and `length` == 1536.
jamal_se: quick repro command I'm going to run in staging: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11","input":["test"],"client_batch_size":1}'
```

expected: model=rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11 and embedding length 1536. actual (prod sample): model=rwd-embed-1024-compat length=1024.
maria_support: customer will stand by while we test. thanks.
eli_infra: pinned enforcement deployed to reserved-tenant-387 pool at 2026-02-11T14:27:10Z. rolling canary for 5 requests now.
ops_bot: [auto] canary_result: 5/5 passed model_id=rwd-embed-1536-lock-2026-02-11 embedding_len=1536
sre_oncall: closing P1 on this thread after sticky pin — follow-up to root cause required (looks like kernel mismatch fallback without tenant-level notice). please file RCA and add a guard in the router to annotate tenant pins in fallbacks.
jamal_se: note for RCA: make router fallback emit `pinned_override` event and include `embedding_dim` in decision log so support can triage faster.
nana_research: adding an eval job to check for cross-variant embedding similarity to catch silent dim flips in future.
maria_support: customer confirmed service behaving as expected after canary. will keep monitoring and re-open if they see drift. :white_check_mark:
ops_bot: [auto] log: ticket INC-2026-3427 resolved by jamal_se/eli_infra on 2026-02-11T14:33:02Z
